localRestore.target: ephemeral or operator-supplied local Supabase/Docker database

scopeBoundaries.database: covered only after a real encrypted export and isolated local restore pass
scopeBoundaries.storageObjectBytes: separate recovery scope; not included in database backup
scopeBoundaries.edgeFunctions: reconstructed from source-controlled supabase/functions and supabase/config.toml
scopeBoundaries.identityProviderConfiguration: separate configuration inventory and validation required
scopeBoundaries.managedPitr: not available in the current zero-additional-cost posture

readinessRule: This contract provides an encrypted portable DATABASE recovery path. It does not by itself satisfy Storage object bytes, identity/platform configuration, managed PITR, authoritative RPO, service-level RTO, or full-platform READY evidence.
